tasks.analysis: We know from drawings that have been preserved in caves for over 10,000 years that early humans performed dances as a group activity. We might think that prehistoric people concentrated only on basic survival. However it is, clear from the record that dancing was important to them. They recorded more drawings of dances than of any other group activity.
